title: Tari Bounty Desk
creator: MarcoBountyDesk / MarcoDiPolo
summary: November 27, 2026: An independent French-language reader of official Tari bounty records, with an offline snapshot, source links and hardware filters. A listed XTM amount is an advertised reward, not evidence of payment. Retrospective awards are separated from open work. The public page’s text shell and complete README were read; its JavaScript filters and refresh action were not executed. This is an off-chain reader, not an Ootle deployment. MIT source and public creator evidence were reviewed. The genuine recording is a source/docs walkthrough with scripts and downloads disabled. No repository code, installed software, wallet or transaction was executed.
cardSummary: Browse Tari bounties in French, distinguish active work from retrospective awards, and filter hardware requirements.
